evidence.detail: set_doorprize() writes to doorprize table but no read/query function exists
Prizes view never fetches or displays doorprize data
Route /admin/prizes/ decorated with @auth.admin_required; no public equivalent exists

triage.fix_sketch: 1) Add `get_doorprizes(week_start, week_end)` to `decksite/data/competition.py` querying the existing `doorprize` table. 2) Update `decksite/views/prizes.py` `Prizes.__init__` to accept and expose doorprize winners per week. 3) Add a public route in `decksite/controllers/competitions.py` (no `admin_required`) pointing to the same Prizes view, and optionally redirect `/admin/prizes/` to it.
triage.notes: No schema change needed — doorprize table and data pipeline already exist. The route move also removes admin restriction, which is the intended behaviour per the issue.
